description:
Hits DataForSEO's Content Analysis index to return open-web content (news, blogs, forums, ecommerce, organizations) that mentions a brand/keyword, with a snippet, and tags each page that is about the brand positive / negative / neutral. The web-side companion to explore_llm_mentions (AI answers) — together they give full share-of-voice across AI and the open web.

Billing: 25¢ per call — one flat fee whatever the limit. Not billed when nothing is found or the lookup fails.

Inputs:
  site_id — the site to attach the saved report to (required).
  keyword — the brand or keyword to monitor (e.g. "Linear"); required unless mode is "domain".
  mode — "keyword" (default) or "domain": search pages naming the site's domain (e.g. "linear.app"), for a brand name other things share.
  include_terms — optional; a page counts as about the brand only if it contains one (e.g. ["project management", "issue tracker"]). Default: it names the site's domain, a tracked competitor or a word from the site's tracked questions.
  exclude_terms — optional; pages containing any are dropped (e.g. ["Grupo", "ebook"]).
  page_type — optional content vertical: "news", "blogs", "message-boards", "ecommerce", or "organization". Omit to search everything.
  limit — max mentions to sample (default 50, max 1000).

Output: { report_id, url, title, keyword, mode, page_type, total_count, sample_count, relevance: {about_brand, listing, own_page, off_topic, excluded}, relevance_note, sentiment: {positive, negative, neutral}, charged_cents, mentions: [{kind, sentiment?, domain?, url?, title?, snippet?, date_published?}] }. sentiment counts only pages about the brand (kind about_brand): not off-topic namesakes, the brand's own pages or its store listings. Relay relevance_note with it. mentions: up to 50 sampled pages, about the brand first, negative first within each kind; empty fields are left out. url opens the saved kind="web_mentions" site_report in the dashboard.

Example: { site_id: "…", keyword: "Linear", page_type: "news" }
